public.meta.title: Quad – School management built around the child
public.meta.description: Quad runs your whole school and keeps everyone who cares for a child close: the teacher, the coach, the nurse and the family at home, wherever home is.
public.nav.label: Sections
public.view.label: Choose your view
public.comingSoon.title: Sign-in opens when schools go live
public.comingSoon.body: Quad is getting ready for its first schools. Once your school is on Quad, you’ll sign in here with your work email. Until then, book a demo and we’ll show you around.
public.badges.appStore.label: App Store, coming soon
public.badges.appStore.name: App Store

public.hero.school.kicker: School management, built around the child
public.hero.parent.kicker: The Quad app for parents, on iPhone and Android
public.hero.school.title: Every child has a {accent}.
public.hero.parent.title: Hear the {accent} stuff first, in the app.
public.hero.school.lede: The teacher who notices, the coach who cheers, the nurse who checks in, and the family at home, wherever home is. Quad runs your whole school, from admissions to fees, and keeps every one of them close to the child they share.
public.hero.parent.lede: Not only when something goes wrong. The Quad app shows your child’s day as it happens: the moment they arrive, what their teacher noticed, and one small thing to try together tonight.
public.hero.parent.getAppNote: Coming soon. The Quad app isn’t in the App Store or Google Play yet. When your school joins Quad, it will send you an invite to download it.
public.hero.parent.already: Already have the app? Open it on your phone.
public.hero.stats.app.label: for every family
public.hero.stats.app.parentLabel: for every child, at any Quad school
public.hero.stats.relatives.label: invited by parents
public.hero.stats.relatives.parentLabel: you can invite, wherever they live
public.hero.stats.quiet.label: quiet hours for teachers
public.hero.stage: A sample school day. Maya’s circle of people, Ms. Okafor, Coach Tanaka, Nurse Haddad, her mum Priya, Nani Asha and her dad Daniel, around a phone showing Maya’s day as moments arrive.
public.hero.parentStage: The Quad parent app on two phones: Today shows Maya’s day as moments arrive, and the second screen shows Ask Quad, a fee to pay and Nani Asha joining the family circle.
public.hero.phone.title: Maya’s day
public.hero.phone.tonight.text: Ask Maya which colours she mixed for the mural sky.
public.hero.phone.ask.question: When is the swimming gala?
public.hero.phone.ask.answer: Friday at 10:00, at the town pool.
public.hero.phone.pay.title: Term 2 fees
public.hero.phone.family.title: Nani Asha joined
public.hero.feed.okaforMoment.text: Maya painted the canteen mural. Her brushwork is getting really careful.
public.hero.feed.priyaThanks.text: Thank you! She talked about it all breakfast.
public.hero.feed.haddadCheck.text: Maya had her water bottle refilled at break. All good.
public.hero.feed.danielTried.text: Halved the pancake recipe together. Ms. Okafor sees it at 07:00.
public.ticker.pancakes: We tried it: pancakes for two
public.ticker.leo: Leo’s back on track in History
public.ticker.fractions: Fractions this week: halve a recipe
public.circle.title: One week, round the circle.
public.circle.school.lede: The small group of people at school and at home who care for one child. Quad uses what your school already records, so good news travels without extra admin.
public.circle.parent.lede: Everyone who looks after your child, in one place. Good news goes round every week, and you decide who in your family joins.
public.circle.moment.title: A moment at school
public.circle.moment.body: Ms. Okafor taps Maya’s name, adds a photo and the skill she noticed. Only Maya’s family sees it.
public.circle.moment.parent.title: A moment arrives
public.circle.moment.parent.body: Ms. Okafor shares a photo of Maya’s mural and the skill she noticed. It arrives in your app, for your family only.
public.circle.thanks.title: Home says thanks
public.circle.thanks.body: Mum taps thank you and it reaches the teacher. Grandma, invited from Lisbon, loves it too.
public.circle.thanks.parent.title: You say thanks
public.circle.thanks.parent.body: One tap sends thank you to the teacher. Grandma, invited from Lisbon, loves it too.
public.circle.try.title: Try it at home
public.circle.try.body: One small idea from class each week. Maya and her dad halve a pancake recipe and tap We tried it.
public.circle.try.parent.title: Try it at home
public.circle.try.parent.body: One small idea from class each week. Halve a pancake recipe with Maya, then tap We tried it.
public.circle.sees.title: The teacher sees it
public.circle.sees.body: At 07:00, after quiet hours. Her family pulse shows which families need good news next.
public.circle.sees.parent.title: The teacher sees it
public.circle.sees.parent.body: At 07:00, after quiet hours, so evenings stay calm for everyone.
public.wellbeing.school.title: Quad notices the child who’s drifting.
public.wellbeing.school.body: When attendance, homework, behaviour or marks start to slip, Quad says why in plain words and suggests the person best placed to help. One click starts a support plan. Try it.
public.wellbeing.leo.textBefore: Leo’s History is down 14 points this term, with two missed submissions.
public.wellbeing.leo.textAfter: Six weeks later: Leo’s History is back up, and Mr. Abara checks in every Friday.
public.wellbeing.parent.title: Watch a week of good news grow.
public.wellbeing.parent.body: Every Friday the app brings it together: the moments, the skills her teachers noticed, days in school, what you tried at home, and one idea for the weekend.
public.wellbeing.recap.moments.label: moments
public.wellbeing.recap.days.label: days in school
public.wellbeing.recap.tried.label: tried at home
public.wellbeing.week.title: A week with Maya
public.wellbeing.week.plant: A plant with seven leaves, one for each moment this week
public.wellbeing.week.idea: {lead} measure the garden in footsteps, then in metres.
public.more.school.title: Everything a school runs, under one roof.
public.more.school.lede: Turn on the modules you need. Terms and grading come from your curriculum, IB, Cambridge, Edexcel or national, so Quad says Year 4, Grade 4 or Form 1 the way you do.
public.more.modules.admissions.title: Admissions
public.more.modules.admissions.body: Enquiries, applications, interviews and offers in one pipeline
public.more.modules.students.title: Students
public.more.modules.students.body: Profiles, guardians, documents and a full history
public.more.modules.attendance.title: Attendance
public.more.modules.attendance.body: Registers in seconds, with alerts to parents at 09:00
public.more.modules.timetable.title: Timetable & cover
public.more.modules.timetable.body: A clash-free timetable, and cover for absent colleagues
public.more.modules.exams.title: Exams & reports
public.more.modules.exams.body: Gradebooks and report cards in your curriculum’s scale
public.more.modules.pastoral.title: Pastoral care
public.more.modules.pastoral.body: Behaviour, rewards, house points and safeguarding with strict access
public.more.modules.fees.title: Fees & finance
public.more.modules.fees.body: Billing runs, sibling discounts and online payment, in any currency
public.more.modules.communication.title: Communication
public.more.modules.communication.body: Messages, news, parents’ evenings and consent forms
public.more.story.title: Mornings start with a few plain sentences.
public.more.story.say: Good morning, Ms. Nakamura. {count} students are in. Three things need you today.
public.more.ask.title: Ask in plain English, see where the answer came from.
public.more.ask.question: Who needs attention in Year 9?
public.more.ask.answer: Four students. From: early warning, registers.
public.more.brand.title: One app for every family, wearing your colours.
public.more.brand.greenfield.name: Greenfield International
public.more.brand.stClare.name: St. Clare’s Academy
public.more.parent.title: Everything you need, in one app.
public.more.parent.lede: The Quad app for iPhone and Android. It’s Quad’s app, and inside it wears your school’s name, logo and colours. Every child in the family is under one login.
public.more.app.today.label: Today
public.more.app.today.title: See their day unfold
public.more.app.today.body: A ring of the day fills in as it happens: arrived at 07:42, lessons, lunch and the bus home. Nobody has to send a message.
public.more.app.circle.label: Circle
public.more.app.circle.title: Hear the good stuff
public.more.app.circle.body: Teachers share small good things, with a photo when you’ve agreed to photos. Say thank you in one tap, and it reaches them.
public.more.app.family.label: Family
public.more.app.family.title: Bring family in
public.more.app.family.body: Invite up to four relatives, wherever they live. They see moments only, and you can remove them in one tap.
public.more.app.quiet.label: Quiet
public.more.app.quiet.title: Calm evenings
public.more.app.quiet.body: Choose what pings you. Teachers reply in school hours, and messages you send at night reach them at 07:00. Urgent safety alerts always come through.
public.more.app.pay.label: Pay
public.more.app.pay.title: Pay in the app
public.more.app.pay.body: See what’s due and pay school fees and trips in a few taps, in your school’s currency, with receipts kept for you.
public.more.app.kids.label: Kids
public.more.app.kids.title: Every child, one login
public.more.app.kids.body: Brothers and sisters at the same school or different Quad schools, all in one app. Each school’s name and colours come along.
public.safe.school.title: Kind and safe by design
public.safe.parent.title: You decide who’s in
public.safe.family.title: Families choose who’s in
public.safe.family.body: Parents invite up to four relatives, wherever they live. Relatives only see moments, and can be removed in one tap.
public.safe.photos.title: Photos only with permission
public.safe.photos.body: Parents choose who sees photos of their child: the class, family only, or no photos.
public.safe.quiet.title: Quiet hours
public.safe.quiet.body: Teachers aren’t pinged from 18:00 to 07:00 or at weekends. Urgent safety alerts still go through.
public.safe.records.title: Good news, not records
public.safe.records.body: Health and safeguarding notes never enter the Circle. GDPR-ready, with data hosted in your region.
public.demo.school.title: See your school’s circle in 30 minutes.
public.demo.parent.title: Want this at your child’s school?
public.demo.school.lede: We’ll set up a sample of your school, with your name, colours and curriculum, and walk your team through a full school day in Quad.
public.demo.parent.lede: Tell us where your child goes to school. We’ll send the school a short note from you and offer a walkthrough. We never contact other families.
public.demo.parent.app: The Quad app for parents is coming soon to iPhone and Android.

email.staffInvite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {school} on Quad

email.staffInvite.expiry: The link expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. If you weren’t expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
email.passwordReset.subject: Reset your Quad password
email.passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Quad account.
email.passwordReset.expiry: The link works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email and your password stays the same.
email.lockout.subject: Your Quad account is locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
email.lockout.body: We locked your account after {attempts} sign-in attempts with the wrong password. You can try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
email.lockout.advice: If this wasn’t you, reset your password once the lock ends to keep your account safe.
email.twoStepReminder.subject: {school} asks you to turn on two-step sign-in
email.twoStepReminder.body: {school} asks everyone to protect their Quad account with two-step sign-in. It takes a minute, and you’ll need an authenticator app on your phone.
email.newDevice.subject: New sign-in to your Quad account
email.newDevice.body: Someone signed in to your Quad account from {device} on {when}.
email.newDevice.advice: If this was you, there’s nothing to do. If it wasn’t, sign out of that device and change your password.
email.otp.subject: {code} is your Quad sign-in code
email.otp.body: Enter this code in the Quad app to sign in: {code}
email.otp.expiry: The code expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Don’t share it with anyone, including school staff.
sms.otp: {code} is your Quad sign-in code. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Don’t share it with anyone.
